local_patch.description: Use the actual returned video/audio tensor width for PDD final all-gather, and use the public all_gather_into_tensor API supported by the installed PyTorch 2.12.0+cu130 runtime. Padding, rank order and float32 gather buffers are unchanged.
changes: final row gather API: dist.all_gather_single -> dist.all_gather_into_tensor
world1-only identity collective branches for failed-verification mirror probe; world2 collectives unchanged
For world2 block projections only, synchronize dynamic NVFP4 activation amax across ranks before original quantize; fixed input scales and weight requantization retain native behavior
Verification only: sample fixed seven global rows per rank around block0 projections and compare to native first forward; no tensor samples written or logged
Verification only: extend sampled-row diagnostic to all 50 block exits, retaining block0 projection samples
Verification only: focus projection samples on block36 and stream complete layer-output byte hashes per global rank window
Verification only: focus projection samples and complete window hashes on block34, retaining all50 layer hashes and the same single packet gather

Verification only: compare actual NVFP4 inputs and cast weights at block34 out_proj, then replay native full-M projection with two actual shard-M windows using the same cast weight/bias and fixed input scale; original native result and gate unchanged

Diagnostic-only first SP2 forward block34 out_proj: preserve native full-M packed layout with original rank row offsets and zero other rows, clone returned rank crop; formal use and continuation beyond the first diagnostic step are rejected.

Diagnostic-only first SP2 forward: apply packed full-M padding to all50 attn.out_proj using one shared installation ballot and 100 target ballots per rank. Bind every returned crop with an independent module post-hook; native oracle, all other projections and original threshold remain unchanged.

validation.scope: Block34 full-M intervention eliminated its complete projection difference; remaining first layer differences occur at rank0 block35 and rank1 block36. All50 out_proj full-M experiment awaits GPU validation and remains ineligible for formal generation.

scope: Diagnostic-only all50 out_proj packed full-M experiment. Other projections and native oracle are unchanged. Formal SP use is rejected; even first-step parity success stops without generation.

diagnostic_patch.scope: Verification-only original native gate and failed-parity world1 mirror; full-M diagnostic evidence logged separately. Formal requests are rejected before group creation; after successful first-step parity this diagnostic-only version also stops without generating a video.

activation_scale_patch.scope: SP world2 50 blocks x qkv_proj/out_proj/fc1/fc2 only
activation_scale_patch.rank_preflight: same target names, dimensions and dynamic/fixed input-scale status
activation_scale_patch.restoration: scope finally restores original classmethod and module forward attributes before final heads and native oracle
activation_scale_patch.replaces: rank-local dynamic activation scale in the original Ulysses candidate; numerical gate unchanged

block0_diagnostic_patch.scope: verify mode first SP2 forward only
block0_diagnostic_patch.comparison: same global rows, all features; samples are internal CPU copies; logs contain only scalar summaries and row/shape metadata
block0_diagnostic_patch.limitations: Sampled rows do not prove full-layer equivalence; out_proj.pre combines qk norm, RoPE, communication and attention.
block0_diagnostic_patch.cleanup: forward hooks removed in scope finally; samples discarded before failure mirror; caller options never contain trace state

layer_exit_diagnostic_patch.limitations: Fixed sampled rows do not prove complete tensor equality; no formal-path trace

final_head_metadata_diagnostic.scope: verify mode only, both SP ranks and native oracle
final_head_metadata_diagnostic.evidence: Stored runtime attributes only; no weight values, materialization, full-tensor hashing or extra CastBiasWeightContext

full_layer_hash_diagnostic_patch.format: SHA256 over canonical dtype, logical window shape and global row bounds plus unchanged contiguous tensor bytes
full_layer_hash_diagnostic_patch.limitations: Bitwise mismatch alone does not establish model-quality degradation; unchanged full-output numerical gate is separate

projection_hash_diagnostic_patch.limitations: Bitwise hash equality compares complete rank windows; mismatch is not a numerical tolerance or a quality verdict. Full-output native parity gate is unchanged.

projection_m_replay_diagnostic_patch.scope: verification first SP2 forward and its existing native oracle only
projection_m_replay_diagnostic_patch.limitations: Uses original bound Linear._forward with same actual cast weight/bias and native input scale; backend and dequantization fallback are not independently proven. M-related execution differences are not proof of a particular CUDA algorithm.

full_m_projection_probe.scope: verify first SP2 forward only; both ranks, all50 attn.out_proj
full_m_projection_probe.packing: Keep existing local NVFP4 qdata and logical block scales at original global row offsets; zero all other rows. No full BF16 input, no requantization.
full_m_projection_probe.crop: Clone original rank window of full-M output before releasing full output storage.
full_m_projection_probe.limitations: Same dimensions and unchanged local packed values do not guarantee kernel identity or full-model parity. Timing is diagnostic only.
full_m_projection_probe.returned_output_binding: Independent actual out_proj module post-hook hash equals cloned crop SHA. Only block34 also binds existing native projection comparison; other out_proj crops are not compared to block residual-output hashes.
